name: Izri
title: Son of Caleb
summary: Izri (also known as Izri) was a son of Caleb, the son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of Judah. His significance lies in his place in Israel's tribal history and genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Izri is mentioned as one of the sons of Caleb, the son of Hezron, in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Caleb
keyEvents.description: Caleb had sons with his wife Azubah and with Jerioth. Izri is listed among these sons as part of Judah's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Jeser is part of the larger genealogical overview of the tribe of Judah, which played a central role in Israel's history and from which David's royal line would come.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Hezron
keyEvents.description: Through his father Caleb and grandfather Hezron, Jeser is connected to a significant family line in the tribe of Judah that traces back to Jacob.
